+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi-K3 specialized decode on MI355X (layer mode), enabled by
+``additional_config={"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}``.
+
+``specialized_decode_config`` runs in the model's ``__init__``, before the weights
+load. It returns None for the stock decode, and raises with every reason from
+``unsupported`` when the specialized decode is requested for a deployment it cannot
+serve. Checks that need the loaded weights run when the executor is built
+(``decode.SpecializedDecode``), those that need the KV cache in ``prepare_kv``."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+AUTO, SPECIALIZED = "auto", "latency_specialized"
+TP = 8
+# a launch's x rows fit one CTA's LDS
+MAX_TOKENS = 8
+WHOLE, FFN = "whole", "ffn"
+# Kimi-K3's text shapes the kernels are written for (hidden size, routed experts,
+# KDA heads, KDA head dim, KDA short-conv width)
+K3_SHAPES = (7168, 896, 96, 128, 4)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DecodeConfig:
+    # rows a request verifies: num_speculative_tokens + 1
+    q: int
+
+    @property
+    def widths(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """The rows a launch serves: whole requests, at most MAX_TOKENS rows. Every
+        uniform verify step up to MAX_TOKENS rows is one of them, so an eager step
+        never pads; a FULL replay pads whole requests the way vLLM's stock decode
+        does."""
+        return tuple(range(self.q, MAX_TOKENS + 1, self.q))
+
+
+def decode_backend(vllm_config) -> str:
+    """The requested decode backend: the one place that reads the switch."""
+    extra = vllm_config.additional_config
+    return extra.get("decode_backend", AUTO) if isinstance(extra, dict) else AUTO
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config) -> DecodeConfig | None:
+    """The deployment's specialized decode settings, None for the stock decode.
+    Raises when the specialized decode is requested for an unsupported deployment,
+    listing every reason."""
+    backend = decode_backend(vllm_config)
+    if backend == AUTO:
+        return None
+    if backend != SPECIALIZED:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"decode_backend must be '{AUTO}' or '{SPECIALIZED}', got {backend!r}"
+        )
+    reasons = unsupported(vllm_config)
+    if reasons:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Kimi-K3 specialized decode (decode_backend=latency_specialized) does "
+            "not support: " + "; ".join(reasons) + f" (decode_backend={AUTO} runs "
+            "vLLM's decode)"
+        )
+    if piecewise_graphs_only(vllm_config):
+        logger.warning(
+            "Kimi-K3 specialized decode: PIECEWISE-only CUDA graphs capture every "
+            "decode step as stock; use FULL decode graphs"
+        )
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    return DecodeConfig(q=spec.num_speculative_tokens + 1)
+
+
+def unsupported(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this deployment cannot run the specialized decode (empty: it
+    can). Config only: the loaded weights are checked when the executor is built.
+    Default-deny: every feature below is refused, the kernels serve none of them."""
+    from vllm.config import CompilationMode
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import (
+        MambaStateDtypeCalculator,
+    )
+
+    mc, pc, cc = (
+        vllm_config.model_config,
+        vllm_config.parallel_config,
+        vllm_config.cache_config,
+    )
+    spec, oc = vllm_config.speculative_config, vllm_config.offload_config
+    checks = (
+        (pc.tensor_parallel_size != TP, f"TP {pc.tensor_parallel_size} (TP{TP} only)"),
+        (pc.pipeline_parallel_size != 1, "pipeline parallelism"),
+        (pc.data_parallel_size != 1, "data parallelism"),
+        (pc.enable_expert_parallel, "expert parallelism"),
+        (pc.enable_eplb, "EPLB"),
+        (
+            pc.decode_context_parallel_size not in (1, pc.tensor_parallel_size),
+            "decode context parallelism other than 1 or TP",
+        ),
+        (pc.prefill_context_parallel_size != 1, "prefill context parallelism"),
+        # the kernels read one batch's attention metadata per step
+        (pc.use_ubatching, "DBO (dual-batch overlap)"),
+        (vllm_config.lora_config is not None, "LoRA"),
+        (vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None, "KV transfer connectors"),
+        (
+            vllm_config.aux_output_config.enable_return_routed_experts,
+            "routed-expert capture",
+        ),
+        # the kernels read the loaded weights in place
+        (mc.enable_sleep_mode, "sleep mode"),
+        (
+            oc.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or oc.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0,
+            "CPU weight offload",
+        ),
+        (vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None, "weight updates"),
+        # the kernels serve spec-verify steps of whole uniform requests only
+        (spec is None, "decoding without speculative decoding"),
+        (
+            spec is not None and spec.num_speculative_tokens + 1 > MAX_TOKENS,
+            f"more than {MAX_TOKENS - 1} speculative tokens",
+        ),
+        (
+            spec is not None and spec.enable_adaptive_verification,
+            "adaptive verification",
+        ),
+        (
+            spec is not None and spec.uses_dynamic_speculative_decoding(),
+            "dynamic speculative decoding",
+        ),
+        # K1 keeps a BF16 conv state and an FP32 recurrent state in place; it
+        # maintains no ReplaySSM / RecoverSSM records
+        (
+            MambaStateDtypeCalculator.kda_state_dtype(mc.dtype, cc.mamba_cache_dtype)
+            != (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32),
+            "KDA cache dtypes other than a BF16 conv state and an FP32 recurrent "
+            "state (mamba cache dtype)",
+        ),
+        (cc.use_replayssm or cc.use_kda_recoverssm, "ReplaySSM / RecoverSSM"),
+        # the model state hooks build the executor and bind it to each KV cache
+        (
+            not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+            "the V1 model runner (set VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1)",
+        ),
+        # plan() and the layer kernels run in forward; a compiled forward would
+        # trace them
+        (
+            vllm_config.compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE,
+            "torch.compile (compilation mode STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE)",
+        ),
+    )
+    reasons = [why for bad, why in checks if bad]
+    shapes = text_shapes(mc.hf_text_config)
+    if shapes != K3_SHAPES:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"model shapes {shapes} (hidden, experts, KDA heads, KDA head dim, conv "
+            f"width; Kimi-K3 is {K3_SHAPES})"
+        )
+    if getattr(mc.hf_text_config, "attn_res_block_size", None) is None:
+        reasons.append("models without AttnRes")
+    return reasons + platform_reasons()
+
+
+def text_shapes(text) -> tuple:
+    kda = getattr(text, "linear_attn_config", None) or {}
+    return (
+        getattr(text, "hidden_size", None),
+        getattr(text, "num_experts", None),
+        kda.get("num_heads"),
+        kda.get("head_dim"),
+        kda.get("short_conv_kernel_size"),
+    )
+
+
+def platform_reasons() -> list[str]:
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return ["this platform (ROCm only)"]
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        return ["this GPU (gfx950 / MI355X only)"]
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import BLOCKS
+
+    cus = torch.cuda.get_device_properties().multi_processor_count
+    if cus != BLOCKS:
+        # every CTA of a launch must be resident: a partitioned GPU deadlocks
+        return [f"{cus} CUs (a partitioned GPU; the kernels need {BLOCKS})"]
+    return []
+
+
+def piecewise_graphs_only(vllm_config) -> bool:
+    """Decode steps captured as PIECEWISE graphs only: plan() runs them stock."""
+    from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+
+    mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    if mode is None or mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
+        return False
+    return mode.decode_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+
+
+def layer_kinds(config) -> dict[int, str]:
+    """Decoder layer -> kind, for every layer a kernel serves: the MoE layers with
+    AttnRes and at least one block before them, minus the MLA block-write layers
+    (none in Kimi-K3)."""
+    block = config.attn_res_block_size
+    if block is None or config.num_experts is None:
+        return {}
+    out = {}
+    for i in range(1, config.num_hidden_layers):
+        if i < config.first_k_dense_replace or i % config.moe_layer_freq:
+            continue
+        if config.is_kda_layer(i):
+            out[i] = WHOLE
+        elif i % block:
+            out[i] = FFN
+    return out

+step, then the layer kernels inside the stock layer loop.

+the loaded weights, builds the per-rank launch state (``runner``) and the layer
+kernels of every width, and compiles every build, before memory profiling and graph
+capture. ``prepare_kv`` binds it to every KV cache vLLM allocates. Each step
+``plan`` returns a ``Step`` or None; ``Step.layer(i)`` is the kernel replacing
+decoder layer i (None for vLLM's layers). Weight reloads are not supported."""

+from vllm.logger import init_logger

+)

+)

+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.peer import tp_agree
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.runner import MonoRunner
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+Kernel = WholeLayer | FfnLayer
+
+
+class Step(NamedTuple):
+    """A planned step: ``width`` rows of whole uniform spec-verify requests."""
+
+    width: int
+    attn_metadata: Mapping[str, Any]  # by layer name
+    kernels: Mapping[int, Kernel]  # by decoder layer, at this width
+
+    def layer(self, idx: int) -> Callable | None:
+        """The kernel replacing decoder layer idx in this step, or None (vLLM's)."""
+        kernel = self.kernels.get(idx)
+        return None if kernel is None else partial(kernel.launch, self)
+
+
+def step_reason(attn_metadata, kda_prefix: str, width: int) -> str | None:
+    """None if a step's KDA metadata (identical on every TP rank) is a pure
+    spec-verify step of whole uniform requests filling ``width`` rows, else why
+    not."""
+    if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict):
+        return "no metadata"
+    m: Any = attn_metadata.get(kda_prefix)
+    if m is None or m.spec_sequence_masks is None:
+        return "not spec-verify"
+    if m.num_prefills or m.num_decodes or m.num_spec_decodes < 1:
+        return "not pure decode"
+    q = m.spec_state_indices_tensor.size(-1)
+    if m.uniform_spec_sequence_length != q or m.num_spec_decodes * q != width:
+        return "not uniform"
+    return None
+
+
+def agree(reasons: list[str], group, what: str) -> None:
+    """Raises on every TP rank if any rank has ``reasons``: a rank that refused
+    alone would leave the others spinning in-kernel."""
+    if not tp_agree(not reasons, group):
+        why = "; ".join(reasons) if reasons else "another TP rank refused"
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Kimi-K3 specialized decode does not support {what}: {why} "
+            "(decode_backend=auto runs vLLM's decode)"
+        )
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """The executor: builds the layer kernels, binds them to each KV cache and
+    plans every step."""
+
+    def __init__(self, backbone, config: DecodeConfig):
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        agree(weight_reasons(backbone), tp.cpu_group, "the loaded weights")
+        self.backbone, self.config = backbone, config
+        kinds = {
+            i: kind
+            for i, kind in layer_kinds(backbone.config).items()
+            if backbone.start_layer <= i < backbone.end_layer
+        }
+        runner = self.runner = MonoRunner(next(backbone.parameters()).device)
+        runner.num_spec = config.q - 1
+        runner.first_layer = min(kinds)
+        whole = [i for i, kind in kinds.items() if kind == WHOLE]
+        runner.kda_prefix = backbone.layers[whole[0]].self_attn.prefix
+        self.kernels: dict[int, dict[int, Kernel]] = {
+            w: {
+                i: (WholeLayer if kind == WHOLE else FfnLayer)(
+                    backbone.layers[i], runner, w
+                )
+                for i, kind in kinds.items()
+            }
+            for w in config.widths
+        }
+        self.kda: list[WholeLayer] = [
+            k for k in self.kernels[config.widths[0]].values()
+            if isinstance(k, WholeLayer)
+        ]  # fmt: skip
+        builds = {
+            b for by in self.kernels.values() for k in by.values() for b in k.builds()
+        }
+        for build in builds:
+            compile_build(build)
+        self.failstop = FailStop(
+            runner.health[FAILED : FAILED + 1], runner.rank, tp.world_size, tp.cpu_group
+        )
+        # (data_ptr, numel) of the first KDA layer's state prepare_kv bound
+        self._kv: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+        logger.info(
+            "Kimi-K3 specialized decode: %d layers, widths %s, %d builds; other "
+            "steps run vLLM's decode",
+            len(kinds),
+            list(config.widths),
+            len(builds),
+        )
+
+    def _kv_key(self) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+        state = self.kda[0].layer.self_attn.kv_cache
+        if not isinstance(state, (list, tuple)) or len(state) != 2:
+            return None
+        if state[1].numel() == 0:
+            return None
+        return state[1].data_ptr(), state[1].numel()
+
+    def prepare_kv(self) -> None:
+        """Checks and binds the KDA states vLLM just bound (the CUDA-graph memory
+        profiling cache, then the real one)."""
+        self._kv = None
+        if self._kv_key() is None:
+            return
+        caches = {k.layer.self_attn.prefix: k.caches() for k in self.kda}
+        agree(cache_reasons(caches), get_tp_group().cpu_group, "the KV caches")
+        self._kv = self._kv_key()
+
+    def plan(self, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors) -> Step | None:
+        """This step's plan, or None to run vLLM's layers.
+
+        Steps that run vLLM's layers:
+        - pipeline-parallel stage inputs, and steps before a KV cache is bound
+          (profiling, dummy runs);
+        - PIECEWISE steps (captured without attention metadata);
+        - widths without kernels (more than MAX_TOKENS rows);
+        - steps that are not pure spec-verify steps of whole uniform requests
+          (``step_reason``).
+
+        Eager steps run the kernels too. Every predicate is the same on all TP
+        ranks: the kernels' mailboxes need every rank on one path. Under FULL
+        graphs this runs at capture only and the plan is baked in; a replay with
+        fewer requests than its graph pads whole requests (NULL_BLOCK_ID state,
+        one accepted token), which the kernels serve like real ones.
+        """
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None or self._kv is None:
+            return None
+        if not is_forward_context_available():
+            return None
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        if context.cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
+            return None
+        width = positions.size(-1)
+        kernels = self.kernels.get(width)
+        if kernels is None:
+            return None
+        md = context.attn_metadata
+        if step_reason(md, self.runner.kda_prefix, width) is not None:
+            return None
+        assert isinstance(md, dict)
+        if self._kv_key() != self._kv:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Kimi-K3 specialized decode: the KV cache was re-bound without "
+                "prepare_kv (ModelState.initialize_kv_cache)"
+            )
+        return Step(width, md, kernels)
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """Once per executed step, from compute_logits (eager on every rank, also
+        under graph replay). Raises on every rank once a rank gave up an in-kernel
+        wait."""
+        self.failstop.after_step()

+"""The refusals that need the loaded model (``weight_reasons``) or the bound KV
+caches (``cache_reasons``), and the fail-stop watch on the kernels' error words.
+Each refusal reports every reason, not only the first."""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import WHOLE, layer_kinds
+
+
+def weight_reasons(model) -> list[str]:
+    """``model``: the loaded ``KimiLinearModel``; every kernel layer's weights as
+    the kernels read them, and the MoE backend that lays them out."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import back, kda
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import moe
+
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    bf, f32 = torch.bfloat16, torch.float32
+
+    def need(name, t, shape, dtype):
+        if t is None:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: missing")
+        elif tuple(t.shape) != shape or t.dtype != dtype or not t.is_contiguous():
+            reasons.append(
+                f"{name}: {tuple(t.shape)} {t.dtype}"
+                f"{'' if t.is_contiguous() else ' strided'},"
+                f" kernel reads contiguous {shape} {dtype}"
+            )
+
+    kinds = layer_kinds(model.config)
+    if not kinds:
+        return ["no layer has an AttnRes latent MoE"]
+    for i, kind in kinds.items():
+        if not model.start_layer <= i < model.end_layer:
+            continue
+        layer = model.layers[i]
+        p = f"layer {i}"
+        m = layer.mlp
+        if not getattr(m, "use_latent_moe", False) or m.shared_experts is None:
+            reasons.append(f"{p}: needs a latent MoE with shared experts")
+            continue
+        if m.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0:
+            reasons.append(f"{p}: routed_scaling_factor {m.routed_scaling_factor}")
+        ex = getattr(m.experts, "routed_experts", m.experts)
+        qm = getattr(ex, "quant_method", None)
+        if getattr(
+            qm, "mxfp4_backend", None
+        ) != Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16 or not getattr(
+            qm, "is_k3_situ_aiter", False
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"{p}: MoE backend must be AITER_MXFP4_BF16 (K3 SiTU)")
+            continue
+        H, LAT, E = moe.HIDDEN, moe.LAT, moe.E
+        need(f"{p} gate", m.gate.weight, (E, H), bf)
+        need(f"{p} gate bias", m.gate.e_score_correction_bias, (E,), f32)
+        need(f"{p} latent down", m.routed_expert_down_proj.weight, (LAT, H), bf)
+        need(f"{p} latent norm", m.routed_expert_norm.weight, (LAT,), bf)
+        need(f"{p} shared gate_up", m.shared_experts.gate_up_proj.weight,
+             (2 * moe.SI, H), bf)  # fmt: skip
+        need(f"{p} shared down", m.shared_experts.down_proj.weight, (H, moe.SI), bf)
+        sharded = getattr(m.routed_output_transform, "row_sharded", False)
+        need(f"{p} up_proj", m.routed_expert_up_proj.weight,
+             (moe.UP_N if sharded else H, LAT), bf)  # fmt: skip
+        for name in ("w13_weight", "w13_weight_scale", "w2_weight", "w2_weight_scale"):
+            if getattr(ex, name, None) is None:
+                reasons.append(f"{p}: experts have no {name}")
+        need(f"{p} mlp_res_norm", layer.mlp_res_norm.weight, (H,), bf)
+        need(f"{p} mlp_res_proj", layer.mlp_res_proj.weight, (1, H), bf)
+        need(f"{p} post_attention_layernorm", layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+             (H,), bf)  # fmt: skip
+        need(f"{p} o_proj", layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight, (H, back.OK), bf)
+        if kind != WHOLE:
+            continue
+        a = layer.self_attn
+        if a.local_num_heads != kda.NH or a.head_dim != kda.HD or a.conv_size != 4:
+            reasons.append(f"{p}: KDA heads/head_dim/conv_size")
+            continue
+        need(f"{p} in_proj", a.in_proj_qkvgfab.weight, (kda.NPROJ, H), bf)
+        need(f"{p} f_b_proj", a.f_b_proj.weight, (kda.PROJ, kda.HD), bf)
+        need(f"{p} o_norm", a.o_norm.weight, (kda.HD,), bf)
+        need(f"{p} conv1d", a.conv1d.weight.view(-1, 4), (kda.QKV, 4), f32)
+        need(f"{p} A_log", a.A_log.view(-1), (kda.NH,), f32)
+        need(f"{p} dt_bias", a.dt_bias.view(-1), (kda.PROJ,), f32)
+        need(f"{p} input_layernorm", layer.input_layernorm.weight, (H,), bf)
+        need(f"{p} self_attention_res_norm", layer.self_attention_res_norm.weight,
+             (H,), bf)  # fmt: skip
+        need(f"{p} self_attention_res_proj", layer.self_attention_res_proj.weight,
+             (1, H), bf)  # fmt: skip
+    return reasons
+
+
+def cache_reasons(caches: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    """Every KDA layer's (conv, recurrent) state as K1 reads them."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+    reasons = []
+    for name, (conv_state, rstate) in caches.items():
+        if conv_state.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: conv state {conv_state.dtype}, needs bf16")
+        if rstate.dtype != torch.float32:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: recurrent state {rstate.dtype}, needs fp32")
+        elif (
+            rstate[0].numel() != kda.NH * kda.HD * kda.HD
+            or not rstate[0].is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: a slot's recurrent state must be dense")
+    return reasons
+
+
+class FailStop:
+    """Stops every TP rank at the same step once any of them gave up an in-kernel
+    wait (its health word FAILED, ``mono.abi``). Each step queues a D2H copy of
+    this rank's word and keeps the newest copy that has landed, without blocking;
+    every CHECK_EVERY steps the ranks agree on those over the TP CPU group and all
+    raise together. A rank that raised alone would leave the others in the next
+    collective (the drafter's) for ever. A failure is seen within about
+    CHECK_EVERY steps."""
+
+    CHECK_EVERY = 16
+
+    def __init__(self, failed: torch.Tensor, rank: int, world: int, group):
+        self.failed, self.rank, self.world, self.group = failed, rank, world, group
+        self.host = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
+        self.copied: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self.seen = False
+        self.steps = 0
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """Once per step on every TP rank (compute_logits, itself collective)."""
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return
+        if self.copied is None or self.copied.query():
+            if self.copied is not None:
+                self.seen |= bool(self.host[0])
+            self.host.copy_(self.failed, non_blocking=True)
+            self.copied = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self.copied.record()
+        self.steps += 1
+        if self.steps % self.CHECK_EVERY:
+            return
+        votes = torch.zeros(self.world, dtype=torch.int32)
+        votes[self.rank] = int(self.seen)
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(votes, group=self.group)
+        if votes.any():
+            ranks = [r for r, v in enumerate(votes.tolist()) if v]
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Kimi-K3 specialized decode: TP ranks {ranks} gave up an in-kernel "
+                "wait; stopping the engine (decode_backend=auto runs vLLM's decode)"
+            )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The layer kernels: each takes and returns what ``KimiDecoderLayer.forward``
+does with AttnRes, ``(prefix_sum, block_residual, prefix_delta)``.
+
+- ``WholeLayer`` (KDA layers): K1 (AttnRes, in_proj, f_b, spec conv, the KDA
+  recurrence, the gated norm) writes o_proj's input; K2 runs o_proj, its
+  all-reduce, the MLP AttnRes and the latent MoE.
+- ``FfnLayer`` (MLA layers): vLLM's AttnRes and MLA up to o_proj's input, then
+  K2.
+
+Weights are views of the loaded parameters, taken at every launch.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import is_conv_state_dim_first
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.runner import MonoRunner
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.decode import Step
+
+
+def _k2_key(layer, runner: MonoRunner, tokens: int, reset: bool):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer as k2
+
+    m = layer.mlp
+    return k2.K2Build(
+        tokens=tokens,
+        nblocks=layer.prev_valid_blocks + (1 if reset else 0),
+        reset=reset,
+        eps=layer.mlp_res_norm.variance_epsilon,
+        out_eps=layer.post_attention_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+        ln_eps=m.routed_expert_norm.variance_epsilon,
+        **runner.fault,
+    )
+
+
+def _k2(layer, runner: MonoRunner, core, prefix, blocks, reset=False):
+    """K2 from ``core`` (o_proj's input): ``prefix`` updated in place (written,
+    when ``reset``), the MoE output returned."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer as k2
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention.kda import HIDDEN
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import moe
+
+    m = layer.mlp
+    ex = getattr(m.experts, "routed_experts", m.experts)
+    w_up = m.routed_expert_up_proj.weight
+    if not getattr(m.routed_output_transform, "row_sharded", False):
+        w_up = w_up.narrow(0, runner.rank * moe.UP_N, moe.UP_N)
+    out = torch.empty_like(prefix)
+    k2.k2_launch(
+        _k2_key(layer, runner, core.size(0), reset),
+        core=core,
+        w_o=layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight,
+        prefix=prefix,
+        blocks=blocks,
+        ares_nw=layer.mlp_res_norm.weight,
+        ares_qk=layer.mlp_res_proj.weight.view(HIDDEN),
+        in_nw=layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+        w_gate=m.gate.weight,
+        bias=m.gate.e_score_correction_bias,
+        w_ld=m.routed_expert_down_proj.weight,
+        w_sgu=m.shared_experts.gate_up_proj.weight,
+        w_sd=m.shared_experts.down_proj.weight,
+        w13=ex.w13_weight,
+        w13s=ex.w13_weight_scale,
+        w2=ex.w2_weight,
+        w2s=ex.w2_weight_scale,
+        ln_w=m.routed_expert_norm.weight,
+        w_up=w_up,
+        out=out,
+        layer=128 + layer.layer_idx,
+        **runner.launch_args(),
+        **runner.peer_args(),
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def compile_build(key) -> None:
+    """Compiles one launch's kernel (a ``K2Build`` or ``KdaPreBuild``) without
+    running it: FlyDSL's compile-only mode returns before the launch."""
+    import os
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer as k2
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+    mod = kda if isinstance(key, kda.KdaPreBuild) else k2
+    launch = mod.build(key)
+    # FlyDSL's compile-only switch has no FLYDSL_ prefix
+    old = os.environ.get("COMPILE_ONLY")
+    os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"] = "1"
+    try:
+        launch(*[0] * len(mod.ABI.names), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    finally:
+        if old is None:
+            del os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"]
+        else:
+            os.environ["COMPILE_ONLY"] = old
+
+
+class _Layer:
+    def __init__(self, layer, runner: MonoRunner, width: int):
+        self.layer = layer
+        self.runner = runner
+        self.width = width
+        # the step's first launch bumps the epoch (a graph captures it)
+        self.first = layer.layer_idx == runner.first_layer
+
+    def builds(self) -> list:
+        """The builds this layer launches at its width, compiled before capture."""
+        reset = getattr(self.layer, "is_block_write_layer", False)
+        return [_k2_key(self.layer, self.runner, self.width, reset)]
+
+
+class WholeLayer(_Layer):
+    def _k1_key(self, qlen: int, state_len: int, delta: bool):
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+        layer = self.layer
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        return kda.KdaPreBuild(
+            tokens=self.width,
+            qlen=qlen,
+            nblocks=layer.prev_valid_blocks,
+            delta=delta,
+            state_len=state_len,
+            eps=layer.self_attention_res_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            out_eps=layer.input_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+            onorm_eps=attn.o_norm.eps,
+            lower_bound=attn.gate_lower_bound,
+            write_idx=layer.block_write_idx if layer.is_block_write_layer else -1,
+        )
+
+    def builds(self) -> list:
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+        q = self.runner.num_spec + 1
+        # the conv state keeps CONV_W - 1 + num_spec entries; a layer after
+        # another always has a pending delta
+        k1 = self._k1_key(q, kda.CONV_W - 1 + self.runner.num_spec, True)
+        return [k1, *super().builds()]
+
+    def caches(self) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The conv state as [slots, dim, state_len] (a view) and the recurrent
+        state."""
+        conv_state, rstate = self.layer.self_attn.kv_cache
+        if not is_conv_state_dim_first():
+            conv_state = conv_state.transpose(-1, -2)
+        return conv_state, rstate
+
+    def launch(self, step: "Step", positions, prefix_sum, block_residual, prefix_delta):
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+        layer, runner = self.layer, self.runner
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        m: Any = step.attn_metadata[attn.prefix]
+        if self.first:
+            runner.step_begin()
+        conv_state, rstate = self.caches()
+        s = prefix_sum.size(0)
+        core = prefix_sum.new_empty(s, kda.PROJ)
+        kda.kda_pre(
+            self._k1_key(
+                m.spec_state_indices_tensor.size(-1),
+                conv_state.size(-1),
+                prefix_delta is not None,
+            ),
+            prefix=prefix_sum,
+            delta=prefix_delta,
+            blocks=block_residual,
+            ares_nw=layer.self_attention_res_norm.weight,
+            ares_qk=layer.self_attention_res_proj.weight.view(kda.HIDDEN),
+            in_nw=layer.input_layernorm.weight,
+            w_in=attn.in_proj_qkvgfab.weight,
+            w_fb=attn.f_b_proj.weight,
+            conv_w=attn.conv1d.weight.view(kda.QKV, 4),
+            conv_state=conv_state,
+            a_log=attn.A_log,
+            dt_bias=attn.dt_bias,
+            on_w=attn.o_norm.weight,
+            rstate=rstate,
+            st_idx=m.spec_state_indices_tensor,
+            num_acc=m.num_accepted_tokens,
+            core_out=core,
+            layer=layer.layer_idx,
+            **runner.launch_args(),
+        )
+        if layer.is_block_write_layer:
+            # the prefix restarts at the attention's output
+            prefix_sum = torch.empty_like(prefix_sum)
+            out = _k2(layer, runner, core, prefix_sum, block_residual, reset=True)
+        else:
+            out = _k2(layer, runner, core, prefix_sum, block_residual)
+        return prefix_sum, block_residual, out
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at a526f0d, MIT License,

+# atom/mono/runtime/peer_memory.py
+# atom/mono/runtime/consensus.py
+"""Peer memory for in-kernel TP collectives: one uncached buffer a rank, every
+rank holding every peer's address, and the TP agreements that must precede
+anything collective."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+
+class _DeviceBytes:
+    """``__cuda_array_interface__`` of ``nbytes`` bytes at a raw device address, for a
+    non-owning torch view."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+class PeerBuffer:
+    """One uncached buffer per rank, every rank holding every peer's address
+    (``addresses``, int64, indexed by TP rank). What lives where, and why no rank
+    overwrites a peer's unread data, is the model's layout's to say.
+
+    ``bytes`` is the whole buffer: the kernels tag every pair with the step's
+    epoch, so it is never zeroed between steps.
+
+    The constructor is collective over ``group`` (the handle exchange, then an
+    agreement that every rank mapped every peer): every rank must reach it, so a
+    runner reaches it only after ``tp_agree``. A failed mapping on any rank raises
+    ``RuntimeError`` on all of them.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        nbytes: int,
+        group,
+        rank: int,
+        npes: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.quick_allreduce_int4_ipc import UncachedIpcHeap
+
+        self._heap = UncachedIpcHeap
+        self.local = UncachedIpcHeap.alloc_uncached(nbytes)
+        # a view, not an owner: close() frees the memory under it
+        self.bytes = torch.as_tensor(_DeviceBytes(self.local, nbytes), device=device)
+        self.rank = rank
+        self._opened: list[int] = []
+        addresses = [self.local]
+        if npes > 1:
+            handles = UncachedIpcHeap.gather_object_list_via_broadcast(
+                group, UncachedIpcHeap.get_mem_handle_bytes(self.local)
+            )
+            addresses, failure = [], None
+            try:
+                for peer, handle in enumerate(handles):
+                    if peer == rank:
+                        addresses.append(self.local)
+                    else:
+                        base = UncachedIpcHeap.open_mem_handle(handle)
+                        self._opened.append(base)
+                        addresses.append(base)
+            except RuntimeError as err:  # every rank must still reach the agreement
+                failure = err
+            if not tp_agree(failure is None, group):
+                self.close()
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "peer memory handshake failed on "
+                    f"{'this' if failure else 'another'}"
+                    " TP rank"
+                ) from failure
+        self.addresses = torch.tensor(addresses, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close the peer mappings and free the local buffer; idempotent. Only once no
+        kernel of any rank can still touch it (the runner is being dropped)."""
+        opened, self._opened = self._opened, []
+        for base in opened:
+            self._heap.close_mem_handle(base)
+        if self.local:
+            self.bytes = None
+            self._heap.free_device_mem(self.local)
+            self.local = 0
+
+
+# Decisions every TP rank must take alike.
+#
+# A mono kernel waits in-kernel on every peer rank, so a rank that turned mono off
+# alone -- or failed to build what the others launch -- leaves the others spinning
+# on the GPU for ever. Each such decision is a local verdict agreed on over the TP
+# group's CPU group before anything collective (peer handshake, launch) follows.
+#
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """True when every rank of ``group`` passed ``ok`` true. Every rank must call
+    it at the same point; ``group`` is a CPU (gloo) process group, or None for a
+    single rank."""
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The specialized decode's per-rank state: one scratch buffer every launch shares
+(their mailbox tags differ), the device step epoch, the health words and the TP
+group's peer memory.
+
+Mailbox tags carry the epoch the model bumps once a forward (``step_begin``,
+which a CUDA graph captures), so no buffer is zeroed between steps.
+
+The peer buffer's first ``PEER_HEAD`` bytes hold the output rank's flags, a
+word a rank (``alarm``): a rank whose wait gives up sets its word there before it
+stores anything else. The kernels see the buffer past the head.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import PEER_HEAD
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import HEALTH_WORDS
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import MAX_TOKENS
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.peer import PeerBuffer
+
+
+class MonoRunner:
+    """Collective: every TP rank builds it at the same point."""
+
+    def __init__(self, device: torch.device):
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import kda
+
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            max(
+                kda.scratch_bytes(
+                    kda.KdaPreBuild(
+                        tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
+                        qlen=MAX_TOKENS,
+                        nblocks=8,
+                        delta=True,
+                        state_len=3 + MAX_TOKENS,
+                    )
+                ),
+                layer.scratch_bytes(layer.K2Build(tokens=MAX_TOKENS, nblocks=8)),
+            ),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        self.epoch = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.health = torch.zeros(HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        self.rank = tp.rank_in_group
+        nbytes = PEER_HEAD + layer.peer_bytes(MAX_TOKENS)
+        self.peers = PeerBuffer(nbytes, tp.cpu_group, self.rank, tp.world_size, device)
+        self.peers.bytes.zero_()
+        self.peer_table = self.peers.addresses + PEER_HEAD
+        self.alarm = int(self.peers.addresses[0].item()) + 4 * self.rank
+        self.flags = self.peers.bytes[: 4 * tp.world_size].view(torch.int32)
+        self.fault: dict = {}  # K2Build's fault_* fields (tests only)
+        self.first_layer = -1  # the step's first kernel layer: bumps the epoch
+        self.kda_prefix = ""  # a KDA layer's name: the step's metadata
+        self.num_spec = 0  # speculative tokens a request
+
+    def step_begin(self) -> None:
+        """Once a forward, before its first mono launch (a graph captures it)."""
+        self.epoch.add_(1)
+
+    def launch_args(self) -> dict:
+        return {
+            "scratch": self.scratch,
+            "epoch": self.epoch,
+            "health": self.health,
+            "alarm": self.alarm,
+        }
+
+    def peer_args(self) -> dict:
+        return {"peers": self.peer_table, "rank": self.rank}

+def generate_hf_logprobs_from_logits(
+    hf_model: HfRunner,
+    prompts: list[str],
+    images: PromptImageInput,
+    max_tokens: int,
+    num_logprobs: int,
+) -> list[tuple[list[int], str, SampleLogprobs]]:
+    """Parse 3.5 exposes generation logits but not decoder hidden states."""
+    inputs = hf_model.get_inputs(
+        prompts,
+        images=images,
+        tokenization_kwargs={"add_special_tokens": False},
+    )
+    outputs = []
+    for model_inputs in inputs:
+        generated = hf_model.model.generate(
+            **hf_model.wrap_device(model_inputs),
+            do_sample=False,
+            max_new_tokens=max_tokens,
+            output_logits=True,
+            return_dict_in_generate=True,
+        )
+        logprobs: SampleLogprobs = []
+        for logits in generated.logits:
+            values, indices = logits[0].float().log_softmax(dim=-1).topk(num_logprobs)
+            logprobs.append(
+                {
+                    int(token_id): Logprob(float(value))
+                    for token_id, value in zip(indices.tolist(), values.tolist())
+                }
+            )
+        token_ids = generated.sequences[0, -len(logprobs) :].tolist()
+        outputs.append((token_ids, hf_model.tokenizer.decode(token_ids), logprobs))
+    return outputs
+
+

+

+

+    }

+
+def _content_normalized_positions(
+    patches: torch.Tensor,
+    patch_generator: nn.Module,
+    image_size: tuple[int, int],
+    content_size: tuple[int, int],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Apply Parse 3.5's content-normalized positional field to one page."""
+    height, width = image_size
+    content_height, content_width = content_size
+    patch_size = int(patch_generator.patch_size)
+    rows, cols = height // patch_size, width // patch_size
+    if height % patch_size or width % patch_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"image size {image_size} is not patch aligned")
+    if not (0 < content_height <= height and 0 < content_width <= width):
+        raise ValueError(f"content size {content_size} must be within {image_size}")
+
+    positional_grid = patch_generator.pos_embed.reshape(
+        1, patch_generator.num_rows, patch_generator.num_cols, -1
+    ).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
+    content_rows = (content_height + patch_size - 1) // patch_size
+    content_cols = (content_width + patch_size - 1) // patch_size
+    if min(content_rows, content_cols) == 1:
+        field = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(
+            positional_grid.float(), (content_rows, content_cols)
+        )
+    else:
+        field = F.interpolate(
+            positional_grid.float(),
+            size=(content_rows, content_cols),
+            mode="bilinear",
+            align_corners=False,
+            antialias=True,
+        )
+    row_starts = torch.arange(rows, device=patches.device) * patch_size
+    col_starts = torch.arange(cols, device=patches.device) * patch_size
+    row_extents = (content_height - row_starts).clamp(0, patch_size)
+    col_extents = (content_width - col_starts).clamp(0, patch_size)
+    normalized_y = (row_starts + 0.5 * row_extents).clamp(
+        max=content_height
+    ) / content_height
+    normalized_x = (col_starts + 0.5 * col_extents).clamp(
+        max=content_width
+    ) / content_width
+    grid_y, grid_x = torch.meshgrid(normalized_y, normalized_x, indexing="ij")
+    sampling_grid = torch.stack((2 * grid_x - 1, 2 * grid_y - 1), dim=-1)
+    positions = F.grid_sample(
+        field,
+        sampling_grid.unsqueeze(0),
+        mode="bilinear",
+        padding_mode="border",
+        align_corners=False,
+    ).to(dtype=patches.dtype)
+    return patches + positions.flatten(2).permute(0, 2, 1)
+
+
+class BartScaledWordEmbedding(VocabParallelEmbedding):
+    """This module overrides VocabParallelEmbedding's
+    forward by multiplying with embeddings scale.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, num_embeddings: int, embedding_dim: int, embed_scale: float = 1.0
+    ):
+        super().__init__(num_embeddings, embedding_dim)
+        self.embed_scale = embed_scale
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return super().forward(input_ids) * self.embed_scale
+
+
+class NemotronParseSelfAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        embed_dim: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        num_kv_heads: int | None = None,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        if embed_dim % num_heads:
+            raise ValueError("embed_dim must be divisible by num_heads")
+        head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size=embed_dim,
+            head_size=head_dim,
+            total_num_heads=num_heads,
+            total_num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.q_size = self.qkv_proj.num_heads * head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.qkv_proj.num_kv_heads * head_dim
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.qkv_proj.num_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=self.qkv_proj.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+            attn_type=AttentionType.DECODER,
+        )
+        self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            input_size=embed_dim,
+            output_size=embed_dim,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.out_proj",
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v)
+        output, _ = self.out_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+
+
+class MBartDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: BartConfig,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed_dim = config.d_model
+
+        self.self_attn = NemotronParseSelfAttention(
+            embed_dim=self.embed_dim,
+            num_heads=config.decoder_attention_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=getattr(config, "self_attention_kv_heads", None),
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+        )
+        self.activation_fn = get_act_fn(config.activation_function)
+
+        self.self_attn_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.embed_dim)
+        ffn_hidden_size = self.embed_dim
+        ffn_intermediate_size = config.decoder_ffn_dim
+        ffn_has_bias = True
+        self.fc1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            ffn_hidden_size,
+            ffn_intermediate_size,
+            bias=ffn_has_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.fc1",
+        )
+        self.fc2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            ffn_intermediate_size,
+            ffn_hidden_size,
+            bias=ffn_has_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.fc2",
+        )
+
+        self.final_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.embed_dim)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        decoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        residual = decoder_hidden_states
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn_layer_norm(decoder_hidden_states)
+
+        # Self Attention
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(hidden_states=hidden_states)
+
+        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
+
+        # Fully Connected
+        residual = hidden_states
+        hidden_states = self.final_layer_norm(hidden_states)
+        fc1_out, _ = self.fc1(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self.activation_fn(fc1_out)
+
+        hidden_states, _ = self.fc2(hidden_states)
+
+        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
+
+        return hidden_states
+

+class MBartDecoderNoPos(nn.Module, EagleModelMixin):
+    """Transformer decoder consisting of *config.decoder_layers* layers.
+    Each layer is a causal pre-normalized MBart decoder layer.
+
+    Args:
+        config: BartConfig
+        embed_tokens (nn.Embedding): output embedding
+
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: BartConfig,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        lora_config: LoRAConfig | None = None,
+        embed_tokens: nn.Embedding | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.cache_config = cache_config
+        self.quant_config = quant_config
+        self.lora_config = lora_config
+        embed_scale = math.sqrt(config.d_model) if config.scale_embedding else 1.0
+
+        self.embed_tokens = BartScaledWordEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size, config.d_model, embed_scale=embed_scale
+        )
+
+        if embed_tokens is not None:
+            self.embed_tokens.weight = embed_tokens.weight
+
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                MBartDecoderLayer(
+                    config,
+                    cache_config,
+                    quant_config,
+                    prefix=f"{prefix}.layers.{layer_idx}",
+                )
+                for layer_idx in range(config.decoder_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+
+        self.layernorm_embedding = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    @property
+    def model(self) -> "MBartDecoderNoPos":
+        return self
+
+    @property
+    def lm_head(self) -> ParallelLMHead:
+        return self._lm_head_ref()
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        decoder_input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        *,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]:
+        r"""Args:
+            decoder_input_ids: Indices of *decoder* input sequence tokens in the
+                vocabulary. Padding will be ignored by default should you provide it.
+
+        Returns:
+            Decoder output torch.Tensor
+
+        """
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(decoder_input_ids)
+
+        hidden_states = self.layernorm_embedding(inputs_embeds)
+
+        aux_hidden_states = self._maybe_add_hidden_state([], 0, hidden_states, None)
+        for layer_idx, decoder_layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            hidden_states = decoder_layer(
+                decoder_hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            )
+            self._maybe_add_hidden_state(
+                aux_hidden_states, layer_idx + 1, hidden_states, None
+            )
+
+        hidden_states = self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        stacked_params_mapping = [
+            # (param_name, shard_name, shard_id)
+            (".self_attn.qkv_proj", ".self_attn.q_proj", "q"),
+            (".self_attn.qkv_proj", ".self_attn.k_proj", "k"),
+            (".self_attn.qkv_proj", ".self_attn.v_proj", "v"),
+        ]
+        params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        loaded_params: set[str] = set()
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            if name.startswith("embed_positions"):
+                continue
+
+            for param_name, weight_name, shard_id in stacked_params_mapping:
+                if weight_name not in name:
+                    continue
+                name = name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                # Skip loading extra bias for GPTQ models.
+                if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                weight_loader = param.weight_loader
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+                break
+            else:
+                # Skip loading extra bias for GPTQ models.
+                if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+            # Track destination parameters, not individual QKV source shards.
+            # Complete fused weights and biases rely on checkpoint integrity.
+            loaded_params.add(name)
+        return loaded_params
+

+class NemotronParseProcessingInfo(BaseProcessingInfo):
+    def get_default_tok_params(self) -> TokenizeParams:
+        return super().get_default_tok_params().with_kwargs(add_special_tokens=False)
+
+    def get_supported_mm_limits(self) -> Mapping[str, int | None]:
+        return {"image": 1}
+
+    def get_hf_processor(self, **kwargs: object):
+        processor = super().get_hf_processor(**kwargs)
+        config = self.get_hf_config()
+        image_processor = processor.image_processor
+        required_settings = {
+            "navit_packing": True,
+            "navit_coordinate_frame": "content_normalized",
+            "navit_padding_mode": "top_left_white",
+            "do_normalize": True,
+        }
+        for setting, expected in required_settings.items():
+            actual = getattr(image_processor, setting, None)
+            if actual != expected:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Parse 3.5 image processor requires {setting}={expected!r}; "
+                    f"got {actual!r}. Check the checkpoint processor and "
+                    "mm_processor_kwargs."
+                )
+        if not getattr(config, "navit_packing", False):
+            raise ValueError("Parse 3.5 model configuration requires navit_packing")
+        return processor
+
+    def get_num_image_tokens(self) -> int:
+        config = self.get_hf_config()
+        final_size = config.image_size
+        patch_size = config.encoder.patch_size
+
+        return (final_size[0] // patch_size) * ((final_size[1] // patch_size) // 4) + 1
+
+    def get_mm_max_tokens_per_item(
+        self,
+        seq_len: int,
+        mm_counts: Mapping[str, int],
+    ) -> Mapping[str, int] | None:
+        image_tokens = self.get_num_image_tokens()
+        return {"image": image_tokens}

+class RadioMBartPrefixMultiModalProcessor(
+    BaseMultiModalProcessor[NemotronParseProcessingInfo]
+):
+    def _get_mm_fields_config(
+        self,
+        hf_inputs: BatchFeature,
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> Mapping[str, MultiModalFieldConfig]:
+        patch_size = self.info.get_hf_config().encoder.patch_size
+        image_sizes = hf_inputs.get(
+            "image_sizes", torch.empty((0, 2), dtype=torch.long)
+        )
+        patch_grid = image_sizes // patch_size
+        patch_counts = patch_grid[:, 0] * patch_grid[:, 1]
+        return dict(
+            pixel_values=MultiModalFieldConfig.flat_from_sizes("image", patch_counts),
+            image_sizes=MultiModalFieldConfig.batched("image", keep_on_cpu=True),
+            content_sizes=MultiModalFieldConfig.batched("image", keep_on_cpu=True),
+        )
+
+    def _get_prompt_updates(
+        self,
+        mm_items: MultiModalDataItems,
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+        out_mm_kwargs: MultiModalKwargsItems,
+    ) -> Sequence[PromptUpdate]:
+        def get_replacement(item_idx: int) -> list[int]:
+            item = out_mm_kwargs["image"][item_idx]
+            image_sizes = item["image_sizes"].data
+            assert isinstance(image_sizes, torch.Tensor)
+            height, width = image_sizes.tolist()
+            patch_size = self.info.get_hf_config().encoder.patch_size
+            num_tokens = (height // patch_size) * (width // (4 * patch_size)) + 1
+            return [1] * num_tokens
+
+        return [
+            PromptReplacement(
+                modality="image",
+                target=[1],
+                replacement=get_replacement,
+            )
+        ]

+class RadioWithNeck(nn.Module):
+    """Vision encoder using RADIO model with custom neck."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: PreTrainedConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config.encoder
+        self.image_size = tuple(config.image_size)
+
+        self.model_encoder = self.get_vit_model_from_radio_config(
+            config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.model_encoder"
+        )
+
+        # Neck components
+        last_hidden_state = int(config.decoder.d_model)
+        spatial_dim = int(getattr(config, "vision_spatial_dim", 1280))
+        summary_dim = int(getattr(config, "vision_summary_dim", 3840))
+        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(spatial_dim, last_hidden_state, 1)
+        self.layer_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(
+            last_hidden_state, eps=1e-06, elementwise_affine=True
+        )
+        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
+            last_hidden_state,
+            last_hidden_state,
+            kernel_size=(1, 4),
+            stride=(1, 4),
+            padding=0,
+            bias=False,
+        )
+        self.layer_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(
+            last_hidden_state, eps=1e-06, elementwise_affine=True
+        )
+        self.sum_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            summary_dim,
+            last_hidden_state,
+            gather_output=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.sum_proj",
+        )
+        self.layer_norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(
+            last_hidden_state, eps=1e-06, elementwise_affine=True
+        )
+
+    def get_vit_model_from_radio_config(
+        self,
+        hf_config: PreTrainedConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> RadioModel:
+        hf_config_vision = hf_config.encoder
+        model_name = hf_config_vision.args.get("model")
+        if model_name is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported vit model type: {model_name}")
+
+        radio_config = RadioConfig(
+            model_name=model_name,
+            image_size=hf_config.image_size,
+            **hf_config_vision.args,
+        )
+
+        return RadioModel(config=radio_config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=prefix)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        pixel_values: torch.Tensor,
+        image_sizes: list[tuple[int, int]] | None,
+        content_sizes: list[tuple[int, int]],
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+        if image_sizes is None or len(image_sizes) != len(content_sizes):
+            raise ValueError("image_sizes and content_sizes must have equal length")
+        if pixel_values.ndim == 2:
+            pixel_values = pixel_values.unsqueeze(0)
+        patch_generator = self.model_encoder.model.patch_generator
+        backbone = self.model_encoder.model
+        patch_size = int(patch_generator.patch_size)
+        num_skip = int(patch_generator.num_skip)
+        num_cls = int(patch_generator.num_cls_tokens)
+        patches = patch_generator.embedder(pixel_values)
+        cursor = 0
+        positioned_pages = []
+        for image_size, content_size in zip(image_sizes, content_sizes):
+            height, width = image_size
+            patch_count = (height // patch_size) * (width // patch_size)
+            page = patches[:, cursor : cursor + patch_count]
+            if page.shape[1] != patch_count:
+                raise ValueError("packed patch sequence does not match image_sizes")
+            cursor += patch_count
+            positioned_pages.append(
+                _content_normalized_positions(
+                    page, patch_generator, image_size, content_size
+                )
+            )
+        if not positioned_pages or cursor != patches.shape[1]:
+            raise ValueError("packed patch sequence does not match image_sizes")
+        hidden = patch_generator.cls_token_dynamic(
+            torch.cat(positioned_pages, dim=1), imgs_sizes=image_sizes
+        )
+        hidden = patch_generator.patch_normalizer(hidden)
+        mask_meta = None
+        if len(image_sizes) > 1:
+            mask_meta = backbone.inter_image_mask_metadata(
+                image_sizes, device=hidden.device
+            )
+        hidden = backbone.encoder(inputs_embeds=hidden, mask_meta=mask_meta)
+
+        cursor = 0
+        outputs = []
+        for height, width in image_sizes:
+            patch_count = (height // patch_size) * (width // patch_size)
+            summary = hidden[:, cursor : cursor + num_cls]
+            if self.model_encoder.summary_idxs is not None:
+                summary = summary[:, self.model_encoder.summary_idxs]
+            summary = summary.flatten(1)
+            feature = hidden[:, cursor + num_skip : cursor + num_skip + patch_count]
+            cursor += num_skip + patch_count
+            feature = feature.to(self.conv1.weight.dtype)
+            output = self.conv1(feature.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
+            output = self.layer_norm1(output)
+            output = output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(
+                1, output.shape[-1], height // patch_size, width // patch_size
+            )
+            output = self.conv2(output).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
+            output = self.layer_norm2(output)
+            summary = summary.to(dtype=self.layer_norm3.weight.dtype)
+            summary = self.layer_norm3(self.sum_proj(summary)[0]).unsqueeze(1)
+            outputs.append(torch.cat((output, summary), dim=1).squeeze(0))
+        if cursor != hidden.shape[1]:
+            raise ValueError("packed encoder sequence does not match image_sizes")
+        return tuple(outputs)
+
+
+@MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_processor(

+class RadioMBartPrefixForCausalLM(nn.Module, SupportsMultiModal, SupportsEagle3):
+    """Native Parse 3.5 causal visual-prefix architecture."""
+
+    supports_mm_device_do_normalize = False
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+
+        self.config = config
+        self.vision_config = config.encoder
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        if not getattr(config.decoder, "causal_vision_prefix", False):
+            raise ValueError("Parse 3.5 requires a causal visual prefix")
+        if getattr(config.decoder, "add_cross_attention", True):
+            raise ValueError("Parse 3.5 does not support decoder cross-attention")
+        if not getattr(config, "navit_packing", False):
+            raise ValueError("Parse 3.5 requires native packed image processing")
+        self.configure_mm_token_handling(
+            vocab_size=config.decoder.vocab_size, mm_token_ids=[1]
+        )
+
+        with self._mark_tower_model(vllm_config, "image"):
+            self.encoder = RadioWithNeck(
+                config=config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.encoder"
+            )
+
+        with self._mark_language_model(vllm_config):
+            self.decoder = MBartDecoderNoPos(
+                config.decoder,
+                cache_config=cache_config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.decoder",
+            )

+        self.vocab_size = config.decoder.vocab_size
+        self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+            config.decoder.vocab_size, config.decoder.d_model, quant_config=quant_config
+        )
+        # Some checkpoints (e.g. compact exports) tie the output head to the
+        # decoder's input embeddings instead of materializing a separate
+        # lm_head.weight tensor.
+        tie_word_embeddings = bool(
+            getattr(config, "tie_word_embeddings", False)
+            or getattr(config.decoder, "tie_word_embeddings", False)
+        )
+        if tie_word_embeddings:
+            self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.decoder.embed_tokens)
+        self.decoder._lm_head_ref = weakref.ref(self.lm_head)
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(
+            self.vocab_size, config.decoder.vocab_size
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_placeholder_str(cls, modality: str, i: int) -> str | None:
+        if modality.startswith("image"):
+            return "<pad>"
+
+        raise ValueError("Only image modality is supported")
+
+    def _parse_and_validate_image_input(
+        self, **kwargs: object
+    ) -> NemotronParsePackedPixelInputs | None:
+        pixel_values = kwargs.pop("pixel_values", None)
+        image_sizes = kwargs.pop("image_sizes", None)
+        content_sizes = kwargs.pop("content_sizes", None)
+        image_embeds = kwargs.pop("image_embeds", None)
+
+        if pixel_values is None and image_embeds is None:
+            return None
+
+        if pixel_values is not None and image_embeds is not None:
+            raise ValueError("Both pixel values and image embeds are provided.")
+
+        if pixel_values is not None:
+            assert isinstance(pixel_values, torch.Tensor)
+            if image_sizes is None:
+                raise ValueError("Dynamic Parse inputs require image_sizes")
+            if content_sizes is None:
+                raise ValueError("Dynamic Parse inputs require content_sizes")
+            patch_size = getattr(self.config.encoder, "patch_size", 16)
+            return NemotronParsePackedPixelInputs(
+                type="packed_pixel_values",
+                data=pixel_values.unsqueeze(0),
+                image_sizes=image_sizes,
+                content_sizes=content_sizes,
+                resolve_bindings={
+                    "n": pixel_values.shape[0],
+                    "p": 3 * patch_size**2,
+                },
+            )
+
+        if image_embeds is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError
+
+        raise AssertionError("This line should be unreachable.")
+
+    def _process_image_input(
+        self,
+        image_input: NemotronParsePackedPixelInputs,
+    ) -> MultiModalEmbeddings:
+        pixel_values = image_input["data"]
+        dtype = next(self.encoder.parameters()).dtype
+        if not pixel_values.is_floating_point():
+            raise ValueError("Parse 3.5 requires host-normalized floating patches")
+        image_sizes = [
+            (int(height), int(width))
+            for height, width in image_input["image_sizes"].tolist()
+        ]
+        content_sizes = [
+            (int(height), int(width))
+            for height, width in image_input["content_sizes"].tolist()
+        ]
+        return self.encoder(
+            pixel_values.to(dtype=dtype),
+            image_sizes=image_sizes,
+            content_sizes=content_sizes,
+        )
+
+    def embed_multimodal(self, **kwargs: object) -> MultiModalEmbeddings | None:
+        image_input = self._parse_and_validate_image_input(**kwargs)
+        if image_input is None:
+            return None
+        vision_embeddings = self._process_image_input(image_input)
+        return vision_embeddings
+
+    def get_language_model(self) -> nn.Module:
+        return self.decoder
+
+    def set_aux_hidden_state_layers(self, layers: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+        self.decoder._set_aux_hidden_state_layers(layers)
+
+    def get_eagle3_default_aux_hidden_state_layers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        num_layers = len(self.decoder.layers)
+        return (2, num_layers // 2, num_layers - 3)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]:
+        del positions, kwargs
+        return self.decoder(
+            decoder_input_ids=input_ids,
+            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:

+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        """Load Parse 3.5 weights and report loaded destination parameters.
+
+        Returning fully-prefixed destinations lets ``DefaultModelLoader`` detect
+        missing parameters. Individual source shards of fused parameters are
+        not independently tracked, matching the common vLLM loader convention.
+        """
+        encoder_weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+        decoder_weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+        lm_head_params = dict(self.lm_head.named_parameters())
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+
+        for name, weight in weights:
+            if name in _PARSE_MTP_WEIGHT_NAMES:
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("encoder."):
+                encoder_weights.append((name.removeprefix("encoder."), weight))
+            elif name.startswith("decoder."):
+                decoder_weights.append((name.removeprefix("decoder."), weight))
+            elif name.startswith("lm_head."):
+                short_name = name.removeprefix("lm_head.")
+                if short_name not in lm_head_params:
+                    raise KeyError(f"Unknown Parse 3.5 LM-head parameter: {short_name}")
+                weight_loader = getattr(
+                    lm_head_params[short_name], "weight_loader", default_weight_loader
+                )
+                weight_loader(lm_head_params[short_name], weight)
+                loaded.add(name)
+            else:
+                raise KeyError(f"Unexpected Parse 3.5 checkpoint tensor: {name}")
+
+        encoder_adaptor = {
+            name: param
+            for name, param in self.encoder.named_parameters()
+            if not name.startswith("model_encoder")
+        }
+        radio_weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+        for name, weight in encoder_weights:
+            if name.startswith("model_encoder."):
+                radio_weights.append((name.removeprefix("model_encoder."), weight))
+                continue
+            if name not in encoder_adaptor:
+                raise KeyError(f"Unknown Parse 3.5 encoder parameter: {name}")
+            param = encoder_adaptor[name]
+            weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+            weight_loader(param, weight)
+            loaded.add(f"encoder.{name}")
+
+        radio_loaded = self.encoder.model_encoder.load_weights(radio_weights)
+
+        # SO400M is constructed without LayerScale in the reference model, but
+        # the shared InternViT implementation materializes identity parameters.
+        # Account for them only after verifying both the architecture and value.
+        encoder_args = getattr(self.config.encoder, "args", {})
+        radio_model_name = (
+            encoder_args.get("model")
+            if isinstance(encoder_args, Mapping)
+            else getattr(encoder_args, "model", None)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""One-step auxiliary MTP proposer for Nemotron Parse 3.5."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import ParallelLMHead
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import AutoWeightsLoader, WeightsMapper
+
+
+class _ParseAuxMTPInner(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vocab_size: int, hidden_size: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_size)
+        self.extra_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
+        self.extra_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor):
+        token_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        return self.extra_head(hidden_states + self.extra_proj(token_embeds))
+
+
+class ParseAuxMTPModel(nn.Module):
+    """Draft one token using Parse 3.5's trained auxiliary projections."""
+
+    has_own_embed_tokens = False
+    has_own_lm_head = False
+
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_prefix={
+            "decoder.embed_tokens.": "model.embed_tokens.",
+            "decoder.extra_heads.0.": "model.extra_head.",
+            "decoder.extra_proj.0.": "model.extra_proj.",
+        }
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+        del prefix
+        self.config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        decoder_config = self.config.decoder
+        vocab_size = int(decoder_config.vocab_size)
+        hidden_size = int(decoder_config.d_model)
+
+        self.model = _ParseAuxMTPInner(vocab_size, hidden_size)
+        self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(vocab_size, hidden_size)
+        self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(vocab_size, vocab_size)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        del positions, inputs_embeds, kwargs
+        return self.model(input_ids, hidden_states)
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        def mtp_weights() -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+            for name, weight in weights:
+                if name == "decoder.embed_tokens.weight" or name.startswith(
+                    ("decoder.extra_heads.0.", "decoder.extra_proj.0.")
+                ):
+                    yield name, weight
+
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(mtp_weights(), mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)

+#### Joint reads
+
+With `"joint": true`, a diffusion model reads several questions from one canvas in
+one denoising step: the prompt numbers the questions, and each answer is read at
+its slot in a `number: answer` line. A one-question request is read per
+question, as without `joint`.
+
+Questions that do not fit the served canvas (`--diffusion-config
+'{"canvas_length": N}'`) are split, in order, into the fewest even runs that
+fit. Each run is one engine request and counts once for admission.
+
+The response adds a `joint` object, `null` when each question was read on its own:
+
+```json
+"joint": {"canvases": [{"questions": ["urgent", "bucket", "tone"], "width": 16, "slots": [2, 6, 11]}]}
+```
+
+- Answers can differ from per-question reads, since the slots see each other
+  and the question order.
+- `usage.output_tokens` counts each canvas once, up to its last slot.
+- Joint reads take the same limits as per-question reads: 64 questions per
+  request, no thinking, and each prompt plus its canvas within `max_model_len`.
+- `/v1/decisions` takes the same `joint` field as a vLLM extension.
+

+def post(server, body):

+

+TICKET: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "state": "Everything is down since 9am. Your invoice double charged us. "
+    "Fix this NOW.",
+    "questions": {

+            "type": "noul",
+            "instructions": "Does the customer need a reply within the hour?",
+        },
+        "bucket": {
+            "type": "choice",
+            "instructions": "Which team should handle this ticket?",
+            "criteria": {
+                "billing": "payments",
+                "outage": "service down",
+                "feature": None,

+        },
+        "tone": {
+            "type": "score",

+def test_joint_one_canvas(server):
+    response = post(server, {**TICKET, "joint": True})

+    assert body["answers"]["tone"]["score"] >= 1
+    (canvas,) = body["joint"]["canvases"]
+    assert canvas["questions"] == ["urgent", "bucket", "tone"]
+    assert canvas["width"] % 16 == 0
+    assert len(canvas["slots"]) == 3
+    assert canvas["slots"] == sorted(canvas["slots"])
+    assert body["usage"]["output_tokens"] == canvas["slots"][-1] + 1
+    for qid, answer in body["answers"].items():

+    body = {

+            "criteria": dict.fromkeys(letters),
+        }
+        for i in range(64)

+    state = (

+def picture(shape: str, colour: str) -> str:
+    """A 256x256 data URL: one filled shape on white."""
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (256, 256), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
+    box = (48, 48, 208, 208)
+    (draw.rectangle if shape == "square" else draw.ellipse)(box, fill=colour)
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    image.save(buffer, format="PNG")
+    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode()
+

+PICTURES = {"red square": ("square", "red"), "blue circle": ("circle", "blue")}

+PICTURE_QUESTIONS: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "colour": {
+        "type": "choice",
+        "instructions": "What colour is the shape in the image?",
+        "criteria": dict.fromkeys(["red", "green", "blue"]),
+    },
+    "shape": {
+        "type": "choice",
+        "instructions": "Which shape is in the image?",
+        "criteria": dict.fromkeys(["square", "circle", "triangle"]),
+    },
+    "round": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the shape in the image round?"},

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("joint", [False, True])
+def test_images_follow_the_picture(server, joint):
+    def read(images):
+        body = {
+            "state": "Look at the image.",
+            "questions": PICTURE_QUESTIONS,
+            "joint": joint,
+            "images": images,
+        }
+        response = post(server, body)
+        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+        return response.json()
+
+    def per_read_tokens(body):
+        reads = len(body["joint"]["canvases"]) if joint else len(PICTURE_QUESTIONS)
+        return body["usage"]["input_tokens"] / reads
+
+    text = per_read_tokens(read([]))
+    for name, (shape, colour) in PICTURES.items():
+        body = read([picture(shape, colour)])
+        # A Gemma 4 image takes up to 280 soft tokens and its delimiters.
+        assert 200 < per_read_tokens(body) - text <= 300, name
+        answers = body["answers"]
+        assert answers["colour"]["choice"] == colour, name
+        assert answers["shape"]["choice"] == shape, name
+        assert (answers["round"]["noul"] > 0.5) == (shape == "circle"), name
+    both = read([picture(*p) for p in PICTURES.values()])
+    assert 400 < per_read_tokens(both) - text <= 600
